title: AutoAnalysis: An automated, self-updating meta-analysis of human-AI collaboration
title_zh: AutoAnalysis：人类与AI协作的自动化、自更新元分析

paragraphs.en: AutoAnalysis自动化元分析综合近两千个效应量，发现人机协作整体优于人类单独工作但逊于两者中更强者。 As generative artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more capable and widely used, understanding when and how humans should work with these systems is becoming increasingly important. However, the empirical evidence in this space offers conflicting recommendations, which leaves individuals and organizations without clear guidance on when to combine human and AI capabilities. Existing meta-analyses can help reconcile these findings, but they require substantial manual effort and cannot readily incorporate new evidence as it emerges. To address this challenge, we introduce AutoAnalysis: an automated, self-updating meta-analysis of when humans and AI work better together, and when they work better alone. AutoAnalysis' most recent run synthesizes 1,955 effect sizes from 420 papers. Across this body of work, we found that, on average, human-AI combinations performed significantly better than humans alone, but they performed significantly worse than the better of humans or AI alone. These findings highlight the important distinction between improving human performance and achieving human-AI synergy and underscore the need to evaluate collaboration against both human and AI performance alone. As new studies emerge, AutoAnalysis will integrate their findings into the meta-analysis, providing cumulative evidence about when humans and AI perform better together and how human-AI performance varies across AI agents, tasks, and processes.
paragraphs.zh: 随着生成式人工智能（AI）能力不断增强、应用日益广泛，理解人类应当何时以及如何与这些系统协作正变得愈发重要。 然而，这一领域的实证研究给出的建议相互矛盾，使个人和组织在何时应当将人类与AI能力相结合方面缺乏明确指引。 现有的元分析有助于调和这些研究结果，但它们需要大量的人工投入，且难以在新证据出现时及时将其纳入。 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 AutoAnalysis：一项自动化的、可自我更新的元分析，用于研究人类与AI何时协作更好、何时各自单独工作更好。 AutoAnalysis 最近一次运行综合了来自 420 篇论文的 1,955 个效应量。 在这批研究中，我们发现，平均而言，人机组合的表现显著优于人类单独工作，但其表现显著逊于人类或AI中更强的一方单独工作。 这些发现凸显了提升人类绩效与实现人机协同之间的重要区别，并强调需要将协作表现同时与人类单独表现和AI单独表现进行对比评估。 随着新研究的出现，AutoAnalysis 会将其发现纳入元分析，从而提供累积性证据，说明人类与AI何时协作表现更好，以及人机绩效如何随不同智能体、任务和流程而变化。
